verdict.rationale: Temporal's docs describe automatic Activity retries by default with a dedicated retry-policy system (backoff, timeouts, non-retryable failure types), and the platform's core value prop is shifting failure-handling out of application code. Community users corroborate this directly ('You can retry any unit easily on failure and specify non-retryable errors... full determinism'), confirming it works in practice beyond just docs. Missing for 10: a first-party or hands-on example showing configurable backoff coefficients/timeouts in code, and independent benchmarking of retry behavior under real failures.
